identity.title: Debugger handoff claim fails when TEMP makes the processing path exceed 259 characters

origin.summary: A workload-removal regression run exposed a reproducible handoff failure caused by the deliberately long D-drive test TEMP path.

state.current_summary: A long TEMP root exposed a net472 claim-path overflow because the host appended .processing plus a GUID. The 2.0.2 repair uses the shorter exact .processing sibling while preserving the claim lock and ACK/NACK contract; focused tests and the exact installed VSIX now pass the former 263-character case on VS2022 17.9.

claims.text: VisualizerHandoffInbox.TryClaimRequest cannot move a published request when the appended processing path exceeds the legacy Windows path boundary in the net472 Visual Studio host.

problem.impact: A user with an unusually long TEMP root can invoke the registered debugger visualizer but receive no image because the VSSDK package cannot claim the handoff file.

criteria.text: The net472 VSSDK host claims and opens a handoff whose current processing path would exceed 259 characters.
Focused protocol tests and an installed-VSIX long-TEMP smoke test pass without adding a runtime workload or utility requirement.

artifacts.summary: Long-TEMP run with the unclaimed handoff and repeated Claim skipped log entries.
Same installed candidate and workload state with a shorter TEMP root; 9 documents, 0 errors, and 0 package protocol errors.

evidence.observation: The request path was 219 characters and the generated processing path was 263 characters; VS 17.9 repeatedly logged 'Claim skipped' and timed out. With the same installed candidate and workload still absent, the shorter D:/OpenVisionLab-TestData/RawBufferVisualizer/v179nw2 TEMP root passed with 9 documents, 0 errors, and 0 package protocol errors.

The aggregate self-test suite passed with the focused long-path claim regression: the request reproduces a former processing path above 259 characters, the new .processing sibling is shorter than the request, content is preserved, ACK succeeds, and cleanup removes the owned artifacts.

The exact frozen 2.0.2 VSIX on VS2022 Professional 17.9.34902.65 published and opened a 219-character request whose former processing path would be 263 characters. The new processing path was 217 characters; MultiLibraryHybrid completed with 9 documents, 0 product errors, 0 package-protocol errors, and no new runtime utility requirement.

events.summary: Owner approved PL-0001 repair as part of final 2.0.2 preparation.
PL-0001 resolved in the exact frozen 2.0.2 package after focused protocol and installed VS2022 17.9 long-TEMP verification.
